notes: Heart rate is the median of the distal red, infrared, and green PPG estimates when all three agree within 5 BPM; ECG peaks are used only to measure extraction error.
A failed PPG heart-rate extraction is encoded as heart_rate_bpm=0 and heart_rate_valid=0 so downstream processing can still produce a prediction.
This manifest describes the public dataset experiment. It must not be treated as the wearable BLE payload contract until the wearable feature formulas are confirmed.
